📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough This pull request introduces OpenShift cloud provider support for cluster-autoscaler, adds a new builder API for configuring autoscalers, enhances capacity buffer functionality with reconciliation metrics and pod resolution strategies, updates CI/CD workflows with pinned action versions, and improves various API documentation and configuration files. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**OpenShift Cloud Provider Implementation**

Implements cloud provider interface with node discovery, instance checks, GPU support, and scaling operations. Machine controller watches Node/Machine/MachineSet resources via informers with provider-ID normalization. Node group scales via MachineSet replicas with support for scale-from-zero, taints, labels, and DRA devices.| |**OpenShift Provider Tests**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/openshift/openshift_controller_test.go`, `openshift_nodegroup_test.go`, `openshift_provider_test.go`, `openshift_unstructured_test.go`, `openshift_utils_test.go`|Comprehensive unit tests covering machine lookup, node enumeration, scaling operations, deletion semantics, instance status classification, template node generation, and annotation-derived metadata parsing. Builds MachineSet/Machine/Node test fixtures with deterministic naming/ownership relationships. Exposes methods to add/delete resources and poll informer state with bounded timeouts.| |**OpenShift Documentation**
`cluster-autoscaler/cloudprovider/openshift/README.md`|Describes OpenShift wrapper provider managing migration from Machine API to Cluster API with contained Machine API-specific behavior.| |**Cloud Provider Builder Updates**

`cluster-autoscaler/builder/autoscaler.go`, `autoscaler_test.go`, `clients.go`|New `AutoscalerBuilder` fluent API for constructing cluster-autoscaler instances from options and injected dependencies. Includes `buildProvisioningRequest` method for ProvisioningRequest pod processor registration.| |**Capacity Buffer Enhancements - Core**
`cluster-autoscaler/capacitybuffer/constants.go`, `client/client.go`, `common/common.go`, `testutil/testutil.go`|Centralized constants for capacity buffer conditions/reasons. Typo fixes in provisioning status functions.| |**Capacity Buffer Enhancements - Reconciliation**
`cluster-autoscaler/capacitybuffer/controller/controller.go`, `metrics/reconciliation_cache.go`, `metrics/reconciliation_collector.go`|Added reconciliation timestamp tracking and metrics collection. Controller now supports clock injection and reconciliation cache updates. New collector reports oldest reconciliation times for new vs reconciled buffers as Prometheus gauge metrics.| |**Capacity Buffer Enhancements - Fake Pods**
`cluster-autoscaler/capacitybuffer/fakepods/resolver.go`, `defaulting.go`, `dryrun.go`, `registry.go`|New `Resolver` interface abstraction for pod template resolution with two implementations: `DefaultingResolver` (applies local container resource defaulting) and `DryRunResolver` (uses Kubernetes dry-run API). `cluster-autoscaler/capacitybuffer/translators/pod_template_translator.go`, `scalable_objects_translator.go`, `replicas.go`, `podtemplate.go`, `scalable_objects/scalable_object_resolvers.go`|Pod template translator now uses injected resolver and managed templates. Added PodTemplate name/generation tracking and service-account volume stripping. New replica calculation utilities supporting percentage-based and limit-based constraints.| |**Capacity Buffer Tests**

Updated existing tests to use new constants and reconciliation cache.| |**Capacity Buffer CRD & API Docs**
`cluster-autoscaler/apis/capacitybuffer/*/types.go`, `cluster-autoscaler/apis/config/crd/autoscaling.x-k8s.io_capacitybuffers.yaml`|Updated CRD printer columns to show status replicas instead of spec, added pod template reference and condition details columns.
